business_meaning: Surrogate key for the savings account dimension row (unique identifier per version).
inferred_rules: Primary surrogate key must be unique; used as FK by fact tables; not nullable.

business_meaning: Unique savings account number from the source system.
inferred_rules: Not null; uniqueness enforced per SCD2 version; should match curate.SavingsAccount.AccountNumber natural key.

business_meaning: Identifier of the customer who owns the account (source system customer ID).
documented_rules: One customer can hold several accounts.
inferred_rules: Not null; referential integrity expected to DimParty/PartyId; multiple accounts may share same CustomerID.

business_meaning: Savings product type code from the source system.
documented_rules: Allowed values: EASY_ACCESS, FIXED_1Y, NOTICE_90, ISA.
inferred_rules: Not null; controls conditional requirements (e.g., AccountMaturityDate mandatory when ProductCode = FIXED_1Y).

business_meaning: Current status of the account as provided by the source system.
documented_rules: Allowed values: OPEN, CLOSED, DORMANT, FROZEN.
inferred_rules: Not null; if AccountStatus = CLOSED then AccountCloseDate should be populated; downstream Balance should be 0.00 when status = CLOSED.

business_meaning: ISO currency code for the account as provided by the source system.
inferred_rules: Not null; value should equal 'GBP' for all rows; any other value indicates data issue.

business_meaning: Date the account was opened in the source system.
inferred_rules: Not null; should be <= current date; if AccountMaturityDate is populated then AccountOpenDate must be earlier than AccountMaturityDate.

business_meaning: Maturity date for fixed-term accounts from the source system.
inferred_rules: When populated must be > AccountOpenDate; typically null for non-term products; should be <= current date for matured accounts unless future maturity is expected.

business_meaning: Date the account was closed as provided by the source system.
inferred_rules: If AccountStatus = CLOSED then AccountCloseDate must not be null and should be >= AccountOpenDate and <= current date; if populated while AccountStatus != CLOSED this may indicate status mismatch.

business_meaning: SCD2 start datetime indicating when this dimension version became effective (from Curate).
documented_rules: Curate keeps ValidFrom and ValidTo; presentation uses these for SCD2 mapping; FactSavingsAccount LoadDate is taken from Curate ValidFrom (DateSK derived as yyyymmdd).
inferred_rules: Not null; ValidFrom <= ValidTo; ValidFrom represents ETL/record effective timestamp; used to order SCD2 versions; ValidFrom should not be in the future (relative to load time).

business_meaning: SCD2 end datetime indicating when this dimension version ceased to be current (from Curate).
documented_rules: Curate keeps ValidFrom and ValidTo (9999-12-31 = current version).
inferred_rules: Not null; ValidTo >= ValidFrom; current version expected to have ValidTo = 9999-12-31; SCD2 ranges must not overlap for same natural key.

business_meaning: Flag added in presentation layer indicating whether this row is the current SCD2 version (1 = current).
documented_rules: DimSavingsAccount adds IsCurrent = 1 for the current version.
inferred_rules: IsCurrent = 1 when ValidTo = 9999-12-31; exactly one row per natural key should have IsCurrent = 1; IsCurrent must be 0/1 and not null.
